WHY_ME.TITLE: Why me
WHY_ME.TEXT: Code is more than syntax to me — it's the art of turning complex problems into clear, working solutions. I'm driven by analytical thinking paired with the creativity to find unconventional paths through tricky challenges. I bring persistence when a bug refuses to reveal itself, and in a team I value open communication just as much as collaborating on the best possible solution.
